Disclaimer

General information, not legal advice. Content published by Property and Rent Consult (PRC) — on this website, in its products, and in its communications — is general information about property and tenancy practice in Ghana. It is not legal advice, and reading it creates no solicitor–client or advisor–client relationship. For advice on a specific situation, engage a qualified professional.

Separation from Rent Control proceedings. PRC provides general guidance and documentation; it does not represent parties in Rent Control proceedings adjudicated by its principals, and engagement of PRC confers no advantage in any matter before any Rent Control office.

Statutory references. References to the Rent Act, 1963 (Act 220) and the Rent Regulations, 1964 (L.I. 369) are made in good faith and reviewed periodically; the statutes themselves are always the authority.

Currency of information. Each Knowledge Hub article carries a "last reviewed" date. Where law or practice changes after that date, the change prevails over our text.
